profile.headline: Sr. J2EE Developer at Fannie Mae
profile.summary:
Highly self motivated and goal oriented professional committed to pursuing a leadership career in software development, web application development and, Enterprise Application Integration (EAI). I have over 10-year track record demonstrating strong analytical and problem solving skills, software engineering expertise, and ability to follow through with projects from inception to completion.

Specialties:  Extensive experience in the full life cycle of the software design process including requirements definition, prototyping, proof of concept, design, interface implementation, deployment, testing, and documentation.
 Proven knowledge of Enterprise Application Integration
 Strong knowledge of Java and commitment to using Java Technology potential.
 Strong knowledge of Microsoft-based technologies, skilled in developing dynamic web applications.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: responsible for Analysis, Design, Coding and Unit Testing and resolving testing defects across all testing cycles of an InQuira Information Manager, Search and Analytics implementation. Focus of work will center around the development of new websites or technical enhancements to existing websites. Construction tasks are the focus of responsibilities which also include documenting designs, coding and code reviews.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer/Analyst (Consultant)
positions.description: Application and Web application developper, expert in Java and J2EE technologies

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
For more than 8 years to date, I developed a good foundation in many technologies, gained experience in many different work environments, and demonstrated my ability to work in various capacities:
EAI/ESB Maintenance and Support Lead Engineer 
EAI/ESB Developer 
Java Swing Developer 
J2EE Developer 
Perl/PerlScript Developer 
J2SE Developer
ASP Developer
